caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden clock with ornate carvings and detailed engravings, finished in a rich brown color. The clock features a large, round, light-colored clock face at the top center, marked with black Arabic numerals and two black clock hands, encircled by a decorative floral pattern in gray. Below the clock face is a square panel bordered by a floral motif, containing a painted rural landscape in mostly muted tones of green, brown, and gray, depicting trees, a pathway, and a building in the background. The wooden frame of the clock is heavily decorated with symmetrical carved patterns, including leaves and scrolls, especially prominent on the side columns and the upper pediment, which is arched and centrally scrolled. The clock stands on four short, carved feet, and the overall composition is vertically symmetrical and set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Shelf Clock
